description: The caller ID name (CNAM) for a US or Canadian number: the name a phone shows when it calls, usually the business for a business line and often none for a mobile, plus the line type and carrier as the network has them today (ports included). A paid lookup, cached 30 days and capped daily; answers `callerId` { name, lineType, carrier, ocn, ported, lookedUpAt }.

number.description: A US or Canadian number, e.g. +1 202 456 1111

name: caller_id_lookup
title: Caller ID Lookup
